style.vernacular: No settlement: Ashmore Reef is an uninhabited coral atoll of low sand cays about 2.5 to 3 m above high tide, with sparse grass, a few shrubs and coconut palms on West and Middle Islands, and large seabird colonies. Any structure in the game is a small prefabricated or corrugated-metal hut, shelter or navigation mast set on bare coral sand, in the style of remote Australian reserve infrastructure.
style.ornament: None: purely functional huts and signs. Navigation lights and weather-monitoring masts (installed on the islands in the 1950s and 1960s), blank reserve notice boards, bare coral sand, tussock grass and seabird colonies.

sources.what: cays are coral and sand about 2.5-3 m above high tide, little grass, shrubs and coconuts on West and Middle Islands, navigation lights and weather stations from the 1950s-60s
East and Middle Islands are major seabird breeding sites; atoll about 26 km across; cays West, Middle, East and Splittgerber
